decisions.reason: An accelerator for green startups is only indirectly related to a machinery maker’s core engineering knowledge, so its learning benefits are uncertain and management is likely to reallocate resources to activities with clearer commercial application.
A bio-based CO2-negative bitumen binder lies far from the firm’s established machinery and equipment knowledge base, making absorption, improvement and scaling harder than for plant-based offerings.

An infectious waste decontamination plant fits the firm’s process and equipment capabilities well, and the highlighted cooperation suggests strong absorptive capacity to refine and commercialise it further.
A mobile mechanical recycling plant is closely aligned with the firm’s core machinery competences, so early market feedback can be readily interpreted and used to improve the product.
